purpose: Form CHG-8 is used to apply to the Central Government for rectifying the omission or misstatement of any particulars in any filing previously recorded with the Registrar regarding a charge, modification, memorandum of satisfaction, or other entry, or for extending the time for filing satisfaction of charge.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: For extension of time for satisfaction of charge, if such filing is not made within a period of three hundred days from the date of such payment or satisfaction; otherwise, not stated in the Rules text.
steps: Prepare an application in Form No. CHG-8.
Ensure the application complies with section 87.
File the application with the Central Government.
checklist: Verify the omission or misstatement of particulars in any filing previously recorded with the Registrar.
Check if the filing relates to a charge, modification, memorandum of satisfaction, or other entry under section 82 or section 83.
Verify if an extension of time is needed for satisfaction of charge when not made within three hundred days from the date of payment or satisfaction.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
